runtime_identity_basis: Source overlay in owner frames and previously authenticated launched package; Godot 4.7.stable.official.5b4e0cb0f / Rapier2D 0.35.2. The crop does not expose the selector or a new runtime receipt per recording.
candidate_basis: Owner explicitly answered Y1 throughout for all nine recordings.
frame_number_convention: Original filename _frame########_, one-based. Capture frames are not solver sample indices; pauses, reset, pre-roll and duplicate frames prevent a fixed mapping.
acceptance_basis: Owner praises impact response and identifies undesirable settling/rotation/lateral behavior; no overall production acceptance or merge authorization supplied.

disposition.pr: draft and unmerged; REM-004/#83 remains open

archive_custody: Original archives unchanged; byte-identical copies retained locally in build/owner-recordings/archives. Raw PNG populations are not committed.

archives.name: anchor-30.zip
archives.owner_report: Barely bounces; no strong objection reported for this short recording.

archives.name: anchor-90.zip
archives.owner_report: Satisfying, realistic impact embedding; slow squeeze-out and side-to-side oscillation are undesirable.

archives.name: angle-45-30.zip
archives.owner_report: Corner embedding is praised; subpixel wandering/snapping for 30 seconds is undesirable.

archives.name: edge-30.zip
archives.owner_report: Expected clockwise rotation is absent at first bounce f35. Right-corner second contact f85, anticlockwise rotation f87 and left-corner bounce f90 feel like an implausible physics ping.

archives.name: excavate.zip
archives.owner_report: Wonky supported angle, falling without rotation, then abrupt leveling on hard floor are undesirable.

archives.name: mass-05-90.zip
archives.owner_report: Satisfying, realistic shallow impact embedding; slow push-out and wiggling are undesirable.

archives.name: mass-2-90.zip
archives.owner_report: Powerful heavy impact is praised; deepest embedding sloshes/wiggles free until about 30 seconds.

archives.name: slide-slope.zip
archives.owner_report: Glide/bounce over slope steps lacks expected bottom-left corner catch and clockwise topple.

archives.name: slide.zip
archives.owner_report: Nearly frictionless glide to wall, then residual rebound momentum/rotation and several-seconds-per-pixel creep are undesirable.

edge-30.observation: First contact is at the Sand edge; second contact sequence reaches the hard bottom. Strong angular response begins near that bottom contact.
edge-30.limitation: Images establish pose and environment, not solver force/jerk, exact collision manifold or a solver-tick alignment.

visual_assessment.other_cases: Selected original frames spanning early impact, mid-settling and recording end inspected for all nine archives. This supports the reported displacement/withdrawal and missing rotation; perceived feel remains the owner judgement.

pause_defect.cause: Space in _unhandled_key_input competes with focused BaseButton ui_accept on key release.
pause_defect.reproduction: SceneTree-dispatched press, repeated echo, release after focusing Pause fails before fix: Space release activated a focused control or toggled pause.
pause_defect.repair: Review Control consumes Space key events in _input before GUI; only non-echo pressed events toggle.
pause_defect.scope: Development review UI only; no native input, physical law, default or ownership changes.

next_work: Separately preregister response/settling characterization across mass/scale, then the smallest justified refinement. Treat support torque, granular tangential response and transition to hard contact as separate mechanisms. Do not tune the vertical multiplier to imitate torque/friction.

independent_existing_edge_trace.interpretation: Angular velocity is already nonzero in the incoming pose after bridge.step, before cellular result application, and remains unchanged by that application. This independent trace supports the hard-contact mechanism distinction; it is not a frame-to-tick alignment of the owner capture.
